## What changed and why?

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For shader or template changes, include before/after renders and
confirm that generated files are current. See [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gokayfem/shader-skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md) for the required checks.

## Technique sources

For new GLSL techniques, link the original references and note the corresponding `@see` / `CREDITS.md` updates.
